title: Why Trump Media & Technology Shares Are Trading Higher; Here Are 20 Stocks Moving Premarket - Benzinga
description: Trump Media & Technology Group shares jumped 69.4% in pre-market trading after the company's CEO issued a statement in response to an attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump. Several other stocks also saw significant pre-market movements.

title: Crown LNG Announces Filing of First Half 2024 Financial Statements on Form 6-K
description: Crown LNG Holdings Limited, a provider of LNG liquefaction and regasification terminal technologies, announced the filing of its unaudited financial statements for the six-month period ended June 30, 2024. The company continues to execute on its strategic priorities, including moving its India and Scotland projects towards Final Investment Decision and exploring opportunities for liquefied natural gas export facility development.

title: Crown LNG Announces Execution of Final Agreements to Acquire Kakinada and Grangemouth LNG Import Terminal Assets
description: Crown LNG, a provider of LNG infrastructure solutions, has announced the acquisition of LNG import terminal assets in Kakinada, India and Grangemouth, Scotland. The deals aim to expand Crown LNG's global footprint and support energy security in India and the UK.
